subject: Exec workshop — venue AV & travel coordination for DeltaWorks engagement
messages:
From: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@deltaworks.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Procurement <procure@deltaworks.com>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, Nov 25, 2026 at 4:12 PM -0800
Subject: Exec workshop — AV and travel requirements (Dec 8-9)

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for running point on the DeltaWorks executive workshop. We're confirming final logistics for Dec 8-9 in SF. A few must-haves from our side:

- Main room for 28 people: boardroom style with 40" side breakout for smaller groups.
- Telepresence for 4 remote execs joining from London (low-latency video + individual mic mixes).
- Reliable dial-in fallback (PSTN & SIP).
- Single-day travel window for most attendees; we need recommendations for a hotel block within 10–15 minutes of the venue.

Can you share: 1) recommended meeting room(s) and seating layout, 2) AV approach (primary system + fallback), 3) on-site engineer availability, and 4) a draft travel/shuttle plan for attendees?

Attaching the DeltaWorks attendee list separately to procurement.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — we need to finalize by Nov 30 to confirm SOW.

Best,
Sophie Turner
Head of Events, DeltaWorks
Sophie Turner | DeltaWorks
Attachment: (attendee_list_deltaworks.xlsx)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@deltaworks.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, Nov 26, 2026 at 9:05 AM -0800
Subject: Re: Exec workshop — AV and travel requirements (Dec 8-9)

Sophie — thanks, and great to be working with you on this. Summary of recommendations below (high level) — attaching a 5th-floor floorplan and our AV spec sheet for details.

Venue and layout
- Primary: Civic Center — 5F Boardroom (capacity 32, rectangular table).
- Breakouts: two adjacent glass rooms convertible to small huddle format (6–8 each).
- We recommend theater boardroom with aisle for cameras + a rear AV rack location.

AV and conferencing approach
- Primary: Managed Zoom Room on Crestron/Intel NUC with a Poly Studio X series codec for hardware redundancy.
- Cameras: 2x PTZ (NDI-capable) covering table and speaker view, plus 1x wide ambient for livestream.
- Audio: Dante-enabled mixer with table boundary mics + wireless handheld for Q&A.
- Fallbacks: SIP/H.323 gate & PSTN bridge (up to 5 dial-out numbers) + local recording to redundant RTMP for legal.
- Network: vendor can provide a dedicated VLAN for conferencing; recommend reserved QoS for the event.

On-site support
- 1x lead AV engineer + 1x assistant for setup and dry-run; suggested onsite window Dec 7 (afternoon) for full check.

Travel and hotels
- Proposed hotel block: Hyatt Regency Embarcadero (10–12 min ride).
- Recommend single pickup shuttle on Dec 8 morning (7:30 and 8:15 departures) and return runs at 5:30/6:15.
- I asked Marissa to draft a CSV with flight arrival windows and preferred hotel assignments.

Next steps
1) Sophie: confirm acceptance of Civic Center and the AV approach.
2) DeltaWorks: provide final attendee names + travel restrictions.
3) We will confirm SOW and add vendor quote (Amit is on this thread).

Attaching: venue_floorplan_5F.pdf, AV_spec_sheet_v2.xlsx

Thanks — Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
redwood.com | vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com

Vivek & Sophie,

Thanks for the details. Confirming we can deliver the AV stack described and provide the following extras on request:
- NDI camera routing + recording to local RAID array.
- Dedicated VLAN with managed switches (we can coordinate with Redwood networking on port mapping).
- On-site engineer (Lead: Marco Diaz) available for setup Dec 7–9; travel + per diem in the quote.

Prelim commercial: On-site engineering + gear rental (2 PTZ NDI cams, Poly codec, Dante mixer) = $4,600 (one-time). Network VLAN & switches = $650. Travel for engineer = $420.

We can do a site visit on Dec 2 morning (9:00–10:30) to validate rack space and power. Attaching vendor contacts file with direct numbers for Marco and the logistics team.
